title: Estimator cost
statement: For a natural number sample size $m$ and a set $U$ of coordinates, the estimator cost is the sum of the cost of a batch of $m$ deterministic membership queries and a cost with zero random-example calls, zero membership queries, and $m(|U|+2)+1$ local computation steps.
caveat: The payload does not provide the definition of the deterministic batch-query cost, so its value cannot be stated more explicitly.
